description: main type: lobbed squash-stretch water orb + droplet trail; impact = crown splash + ripples
background: fully transparent (1-bit alpha), palette-only opaque pixels
loop: gif loop=0 is set; play ONCE in game (remove after total_ms)
sheet_layout: horizontal strip, frame i at x=i*frame_w

anchor.usage: draw the frame at (target_centre_x - anchor.x*k, target_centre_y - anchor.y*k) at its natural aspect, k = display px per 2x px; flip_x for the player side mirrors around anchor: x' = frame_w - anchor.x

aseprite.gif_note: pixels/durations from Aseprite's GIF export, re-wrapped with disposal=2 on every frame
